title: $d$-to-$1$ Games Conjecture
exact_target: For every integer $d\geq2$ and every $s>0$, does there exist an alphabet size $k$ such that it is NP-hard to distinguish satisfiable $d$-to-$1$ Label-Cover instances from instances of value at most $s$?
